title: James Davolos on the MicroCapClub: A Deep Dive on Exchanges (October 2026)

James Davolos on the MicroCapClub: A Deep Dive on Exchanges (October 2026)

10/21/2026
Viewing Time: 1 hour 6 minutes

James Davolos joins David Barbato on the MicroCapClub Community to explain why exchanges have outperformed their local markets over the past 20 years, why derivatives are the strongest moat in the industry and why inflation and volatility can benefit exchanges. The conversation wraps up with James’ reflections on the late Murray Stahl, Co-Founder of Horizon Kinetics.
